title.zh-CN: 已退出的渲染不再显示卡住
title.en: Exited renders no longer look stuck

detail.zh-CN: 渲染进程退出后，它的进程号若被别的程序用上，作业以前会一直显示“可能卡住了”；现在会判为进程已丢失，托管队列也不再被它占着。
detail.en: When a render's process had exited and its process ID was reused by another program, the job stayed “possibly stuck”; it is now shown as lost and no longer holds the hosted queue.

detail.zh-CN: multiplane wait 等的作业进程已退出、进程号又被复用时，以前会一直等下去；现在以 internal_error 结束。
detail.en: If the job's process had exited and its process ID was reused, multiplane wait kept waiting; it now ends with internal_error.
